The three-dimensional behaviour near the crack front is simulated through numerical analysis with ABAQUS code, and J-integral method is used to determinate the curves of K evolution along the thickness. The results were studied according to a series of parameters characterizing the curves.

Author Keywords: 3D finite element analysis, stress intensity factor (SIF), impact factor

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation of Microcirculation Traffic Organization Optimization in old Urban Area Based on Microscopic Simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Generally speaking, it is difficult to improve the road capacity through reconstruction and expansion in the old urban area, and its traffic congestion has become a prominent manifestation of urban traffic problems. This paper analyses the process of setting up one-way traffic in microcirculation network taking the old urban area of Jinhua City, Zhejiang Province as an example, based on the redistribution of traffic demand and channelization of intersections, a traffic organization optimization plan was proposed, and the optimization plan was simulated and analyzed using VISSIM. The effect of the plan was evaluated from a micro perspective from the perspectives of queue length, travel time and delay. It is shown that after the implementation of the traffic organization optimization plan, the overall traffic operation efficiency in the area has been effectively improved, which has a good effect on preventing and alleviating traffic congestion.

articleTitle: Research on ESD Protection Design Principle of FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Electro-Static Discharge (ESD) protection design is one of the indispensable reliability designs in chip research and development. This paper first expounds the concept of ESD protection design, and then, according to the characteristics of the industrial Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) chip, proposes ESD protection scheme suitable for the FPGA chip by dividing the chip area, determining the chip power supply strategy and applying on-chip ESD structure. Due to the Harsh electromagnetic industrial environment, system-level ESD protection was also considered in this FPGA chip to enhance both chip-level and system-level ESD protection.

articleTitle: The Cluster Radioactivity of Superheavy Nuclei ^306-339 126 Isotopes
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: As an important decay model of unstable superheavy nuclei, the cluster radioactivity half-lives of the ^306-339 126 isotopes is calculated by using universal decay law (UDL formula) and the scaling law of Horoi (Horoi formula), which can describe cluster radioactivity very well. The result of the two formulas' calculation is compared and analyzed. it shows that there is a long half-life at N=200 and 206. And ^318 126 is extremely unstable in cluster radioactivity.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Failure Model of Composite Laminates with Holes
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Based on the user-defined field subroutine, a three-dimensional failure model of composite laminate with a hole was established. Puck criterion was used to determine the failure of composite materials, and the properties of materials were exponentially attenuated according to the failure mode. The secondary stress criterion and B-K criterion were used to determine the initial failure and final failure of the interface. Then, the compression failure process of laminates with holes was simulated and verified by experiments. The results show that the predicted strength, failure mode and strain distribution are consistent with the test, and the error is only -4.49%.

articleTitle: Research on Improving the Second Pressing Quality of Asphere Lens
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Optical elements are playing the important role in the modern world. In this paper, a new two-step isothermal glass molding process was proposed and the mechanisms were analyzed. Finite element simulation was conducted to analyze the key factors such as the pressing load, molding time and residual stress of lens. The results showed that the two-step isothermal glass lens molding process may decrease residual stress and improve stress and strain distribution and prolong the service life of dies.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Railway Freight Train Attitude and Center of Gravity Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development of the express delivery industry, the demand for freight trains on high-speed railways has surged, and monitoring of their operational safety has become increasingly important. However, many re-searches on the operation status of high-speed freight trains at home and abroad cannot meet the complex and changeable characteristics of high-speed railways. Therefore, using the quaternion self-fusion algorithm and the first-order complementary filtering algorithm, the existing inertial sensor MPU-6050, combined with wireless serial communication technology and Lab-VIEW software on the host, designed a strong real-time, stable Good train condition monitoring system. Through the system's static test and dynamic inspection, the accuracy and stability of the system data were evaluated, and the need for real-time monitoring of train operating conditions was met.

articleTitle: A Classification Approach to Text Normalization
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: We propose a new model for text normalization: GRFE (Gated Recurrent Feature Extractor). With neural network GRU, it classifies the token into predefined types such as date, time, digit. and then normalized the tokens according to domain knowledge. GRFE can avoid many "silly errors" such as it won't normalize '17' as 'eighteen' or blending British English and American English in Date, and enhance the robustness and extendibility of the network. Experiments show that compared with the previous models, GRFE exploits less parameters and fewer layers. The number of parameters of GRFE is 30.69% of LSTM and 34.96% of CFE (Causal Feature Extractor). It takes less training time to achieve a better accuracy (92.77%).

articleTitle: Flexible Pulse Sensor Based on PDMS/MWCNTs
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this paper, a flexible conductive composite was prepared by doping MWCNTs (Multi-walled carbon nanotubes) in PDMS (Polydimethylsiloxane). The resistance of the composite changes with the variation of pressure in a certain pressure range. The electrical properties of composites with different PDMS/MWCNTs mass ratios were studied and tested. When the mass of MWCNTs is 8% of PDMS, PDMS/MWCNTs composites are optimal for preparing pressure sensors. Therefore, a PDMS/MWCNTs composite with a mass content of 8% MWCNTs was used to prepare a flexible pulse sensor. The pulse sensor can detect small pressure and has high sensitivity (0.13 kPa^-^1), and has good stability and short response time (<47 ms).

articleTitle: The Drowsy Testing System According to Deep-Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The danger of drowsy driving to public transportation is merely inferior to drunk driving; therefore this research principally defines a testing method of drowsy driving. Thus, this paper optimizes the algorithm according to the YOLO v3. Through attaching an attention device, the network can concentrate on the eyes and mouth of the person appropriately, and improve the network composition to advance the testing speed. Via measuring the rate of closed eyes, the frequency of yawning, and the detection of closed eyes various times in a unit time, the three criteria utilized to discover whether the driver has a drowsy driving condition. After examination, associated with other testing techniques, the method in this article has a noticeable improvement in testing precision and rate.

articleTitle: Research on Vehicles with Fake License Plates Excavating Based on the Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The current development of urban traffic is analyzed in this paper. And the data is analyzed and cleaned which is collected by the traffic system. Data mining algorithm is used to mine the license plate vehicles. The practice proves that the algorithm is feasible and effective.

Author Keywords: data mining data cleaning vehicles with fake license plates statistics

articleTitle: The Finite Element Model Development of Lumbar Fatigue for 55-65 Years Elder Chinese Women
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In this study, A lumbar finite element model (FEM) with specific bone mineral density (BMD) and geometry of Chinese 55-65 years old women were developed and validated. The material properties of elder women lumbar vertebra was modified according to degenerated bone mineral density, and geometry was adjusted based on 55-65 years old women's intervertebral disc height. In order to ensure the biofidelity of our model, we removed the muscle, then lumbar FE model was validated by comparing its predictions with range of motion (ROM) observed in vitro under the flexion (8 Nm), extension (6 Nm) loading condition without preloading.

articleTitle: The Optimization and Application of Blended Teaching Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The intelligent learning space, logical reasoning, deep learning, processing and perception of complex situations contained in artificial intelligence can bring significant changes to the development of blended learning. The influence of artificial intelligence on the blended learning is mainly reflected in breaking the traditional physical space to create the ecology of teacher-student interaction, promoting the personalized development of students' thinking, and optimizing the evaluation methods of students' quality. The paper explores the development of artificial intelligence related to the construction of personalized teaching resources, the promotion of interactive teaching and the integration of classroom teaching and online learning.

articleTitle: A Graph-Based Pipe Layout Method Considering Clamp Constraint for Aero-Engine
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Pipe layout for aero-engine is generally formulated as seeking the shortest collision-free pipe paths in constrained space while meeting certain engineering constraints. In particular, the constraints of clamp layout need to be considered as well, which makes the problem be more complex. In this paper, a pipe layout method considering clamp constraints for aero-engine is presented. A surface visibility graph routing method is used as a basic routing principle, and a layout strategy considering clamp positions, engineering rules and expert experience is designed. The method aims to pave pipes appropriately in aero-engine constrained space, while meeting clamp constraints. Several routing examples are performed on a simplified aero-engine piping model, which demonstrates the effectiveness of the presented layout method.

Author Keywords: pipe layout, clamp constraints, aero-engine, optimization

articleTitle: Corrosion Assessment of Carbon Steel Using Texture and Color Features
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper presents an assessment method for the corrosion evaluation of carbon steel. The digital image processing technology is used to extract the texture and color characteristics of rusted carbon steel images. First, Q235 carbon steel images with different degrees of corrosion were collected by digital camera and microscope. Second, the texture features of rusted carbon steel surface are extracted based on Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix, the color features are extracted using color moments. Third, the extracted features are combined and normalized as the inputs of Support Vector Machine (SVM) for training and classification. We use Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to optimize the SVM classifier. The accuracy of the classification is up to 97.5%.

articleTitle: In-Situ Polarization Enhanced High-Sensitivity Acoustic Locating and Recognition Sensor Based on Flexible PVDF-TrFE Film Array
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This study described a miniaturized, flexible, and highly sensitive sound locating and recognition sensor. It is achieved by using a polyvinylidene fluoride-trifluoroethylene (PVDF-TrFE) film to enhance piezoelectric performance by in-situ polarization. The high piezoelectric coefficient enhances the acoustic-electric conversion capability of the sensor. By using our polarizing system, the PVDF-TrFE film can be polarized in 5 minutes at room temperature. Compared with the traditional polarization method, the in-situ polarization system has the advantages of higher piezoelectric coefficient, more uniform d33 distribution and higher production efficiency. The sound locating and recognition sensor can generate a voltage response by inducing a sound signal to locate the sound source and analyse the voltage signal to obtain the frequency of the sound source. These can be used to accurately identify complex sound signals with different frequencies and intensities. In addition, the sensor is self-powered. All the above features make it have great potential in various applications, such as biometrics, environmental protection and artificial intelligence.

Author Keywords: PVDF-TrFE, frequency recognition, piezoelectric effect, acoustic sensor

articleTitle: The Development Direction of Electric Air Compressor for Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, with the steady development of pure electric passenger cars, the electric air compressor for vehicle(hereinafter referred to as the the electric air compressor) is constantly being replaced. At the same time, due to the principle of survival of the fittest in the market, the manufacturers of electric air compressors are actively seeking development direction. Combining with the market application of electric air compressor, this paper briefly discusses the development direction of electric air compressor.

articleTitle: The Microservice Architecture of Airline's Group-CRM Based on UML
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development of industrial interconnection, Customer Relationship Management plays an important role on airlines' servicing and marketing as core competence and brand reputation is determined by customer relationship. In order to fit the globalization and promote the profit from group customer efficiently, airline companies urgently need to establish the personalized Group-CRM, which will be fully applied in controlling service process and making great profit. Aimed at this goal, we proposed a Group-CRM microservice architecture in Unified Modeling Language. Rabbit MQ and ETL are applied in data interaction with related service. Meanwhile, solution in this paper can be widely referenced for other large-scale airline companies and related industry.

articleTitle: The Developments of an Intelligent Instrument for Cervical Vertebra Health Care and a Designing Machine for Motion Parameters of the Jaw Support
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This project is to invent an intelligent instrument for cervical vertebra health care to avoid cervical vertebra overuse injury caused by working on the table for long hours. With program controlling, there are four operation modes, including the load reducing mode, the shaking and relaxing mode, the massage belt working mode and the electrical pulse treatment mode, and the jaw support could perform 6-DOF compound motion. A designing machine for motion parameters of the jaw support was also invented. With the application of computer and sensors, it can accurately simulate the massage of professional physicians and produce motion locus of jaw support and the motion parameters for all parts of the instrument. Comparing with the traditional mechanism designing method, it can improve design efficiency and quality significantly. Lastly, build a scheme library with the better comprehensive performance for the intelligent cervical vertebra health care instrument.

articleTitle: Aggregated Power Prediction of Thermostatically Controlled Loads Based on Multi-scale Residual Gated Recurrent Unit Network
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Residential Thermostatically Controlled Loads (TCLs) takes a large proportion in the power grid, but the distributive characteristics would make it difficult for dispatch centers to directly get their aggregated power. In order to get TCLs to participate in the power grid operation, this paper proposed a multi-scale residual gate recurrent unit network to predict the aggregated power of TCLs. This method first extracts multi-scale feature information by multi-scale convolution, then uses residual learning to deepen the network structure to further improve the performance of the algorithm, and finally uses the gating mechanism of gated loop unit network to update and maintain higher-order semantic feature information. The experimental results show that the prediction model proposed in this paper has better prediction effect.

Author Keywords: Thermostatically Controlled Load, power prediction, Mres-GRU

articleTitle: Research and Application of Engineering Digital Expression Method in UHV Line Engineering Construction Management
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: UHV power grid project has the characteristics of high voltage level, large transmission capacity and long transmission distance. With the concept of "digital grid", the application of digital results of power grid project will face more demands. Based on the analysis of UHV power grid project, this paper puts forward a method of full digital expression of UHV power grid line project by using spatial information and three-dimensional visualization technology, which effectively assists the construction and management of UHV power grid line project, and also lays a foundation for data sharing and application of digital results of power grid project. Foundation.

Author Keywords: UHV power grid Digital power grid Spatial information full digitization Engineering construction management

articleTitle: Inplementation of PCM Coding and Decoding Algorithm Based on C Language
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the A-law 13 polyline coding algorithm lacks a specific programming language simulation, C language is used to implement the algorithm in this paper. First, the polar code is obtained according to the positive and negative sample values. Then the paragraph code and the inner code are obtained and finally decoded. Experimental results show that the program can realize A-law 13 polyline encoding and decoding, and for a given sample value, it can obtain its 8-bit encoding. Compared with the bit-wise encoding method, the program is more efficient.

articleTitle: Error Compensation of Yaw and Pitch Deformation on Roll Angle Measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Aiming at the double grating torsion deformation measurement scheme, we study the influence of yaw and pitch angle changes on the roll angle measurement, and propose a corresponding error compensation method. First, the math-ematical model is established by analyzing the relationship between the yaw, pitch deformation and the geometric projection of the grating. The model shows that measurement error is also affected by the magnitude of the roll angle itself. In the experiment, the high precision multi-tooth indexing table is used to simulate the yaw deformation, and the collected data is used for polynomial fitting analysis. Finally, the accuracy of roll angle measurement can be guaranteed within 3.5" after 3-order polynomial compensation.

articleTitle: Chinese Sentence Compression Algorithm Based on Deep Analysis of Sentence Hierarchy in Multiple Application Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, people have paid more and more attention to how to obtain high-value information from massive data, and the demand for efficiency and accuracy has also increased. As a basic technology to solve this problem, sentence compression technology can be widely used in machine translation, question answering system, and generating abstracts. Given that the proposed strategy for Chinese sentence compression is less than English sentence compression, the actual value of Chinese-related sentence compression is self-evident. In the current practical context, the problems encountered in sentence compression are as follows: First, the traditional sentence compression methods are mostly based on parallel corpora of "original sentences-compressed sentences". Parallel corpora are usually difficult to build or obtain. The corpus is even more scarce. Second, sentence compression is relatively rigid, and you cannot choose a flexible compression strategy based on the application. Based on the above practical background, this paper proposes a Chinese sentence compression algorithm that does not rely on parallel corpus and deep analysis of sentence hierarchy in multiple application scenarios. The three compression methods are compared: manual compression, only compression using rules, and compression based on deep analysis of sentence hierarchies. The experimental results show that the Chinese sentence compression algorithm based on deep analysis of sentence hierarchies can be used to some extent according to different application scenarios, reducing or increasing the compression ratio flexibly and appropriately within the acceptable range to obtain a better / slightly lower amount of information and grammatical retention. The compression effect under the comprehensive index is significantly better than the previous two compression methods, and can bring more flexible and realistic compression effects according to the actual application scenario.

articleTitle: The Information Management and Service of Open Scientific Data for University Library in the Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper discusses the information management and service of open scientific data in university library in the big data era and analyze the open channels and application and service method of data information resource for the university library to get scientific data and information resources.

articleTitle: System Design and Mathematical Analysis of Self-Adjusting Stable PLL
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper proposes a self-adjusting stable phase-locked loop circuit. According to the change of the frequency division ratio, it can use the code generated by the encoder to control charge pump charge and discharge current. Then it can change the PLL loop phase margin and fix phase margin at the required range to ensure the stability of the phase-locked loop at the same time. It also can guarantee the speed of the phase-locked loop. Meanwhile the paper has carried on the system design and mathematical analysis about the self-adjusting stable phase-locked loop circuit.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Emotional Intelligent Robot for Empty Nesters
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development and progress of science and technology, the research and transformation of robots is more specific and more diversified. The progress of emotional robots is the current development trend, and it is necessary to integrate emotional robots into the aged care service by combining "Internet +" technology. Through intelligent robots, empty nesters are provided with emotional care, family communication, drug management, health management, entertainment and other service projects, which not only bring emotional comfort and security to empty nesters, but also meet the wishes of their children to support and care for them.

articleTitle: Application Research of Civil Aviation Mobile Government System
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With government work mode innovation, a variety of e-government came into being. civil aviation government departments also increase the construction of information office. this paper takes the mobile government system of east China civil aviation administration bureau as an example to describe the system structure, functional modules in detail.

articleTitle: Lattice Dynamics and Elastic Properties of Wurtzite AlN and GaN
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: We report the results of a first principles study of lattice dynamical and elastic properties of wurtzite AlN and GaN. The calculations have been carried out within density-functional perturbation theory framework, employing the local density functional approximation with norm-conserving pseudopotentials and a plane-wave basis set. Firstly, the ground state structure parameters are obtained by minimizing the energy. Based on optimized structural parameters, the phonon frequencies of wurtzite AlN and GaN are calculated. Detailed comparisons are made with the available measured values and with results obtained in previous theoretical studies. The short-range inter-atomic force exceeds the Coulomb electrostatic force for wurtzite AlN and GaN. Two different methods are used to calculate their elastic constants. In order to better explain the elastic behavior of these crystals, based on the calculated elastic constants, Young's modulus of (0001) planes for wurtzite AlN and GaN are calculated.

articleTitle: Research on Compressed Sensing in Ultrasound Imaging
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The classic Nyquist sampling frequency usually causes the amount of sampled signal data to be too large, which is not conducive to storage and transmission. In order to reduce the amount of ultrasound imaging data and facilitate data storage, compressed sensing theory is used. Compressed sensing theory not only reduces the sampling frequency of RF signals, but also obtains a small amount of data. This article studies the basic theory of compressed sensing and its key technologies, and finally summarizes its application in other fields.

articleTitle: Automatic Air Conditioner Controller Design of Automobile Based on Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper introduces the design method of automotive automatic air conditioner controller based on temperature and photo sensor. This paper also introduces the application of different sensor, temperature control method and algorithm, throttle control algorithm, blower control algorithm. From the control result graph of automatic air conditioner under environment emulation laboratory, we can know that the temperature control is good enough.

articleTitle: Research on Scheduling of Vehicle Cloud Storage Resource
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: This paper proposes a virtual machine-based vehicle cloud resource scheduling scheme. First, the resource requesting vehicle sends a transmission request and status information to other vehicles within its communication range. Then, other vehicles within the communication range informs the requester what resource it can provide according to the received request information. Finally the requester publish and perform the scheduling results. The resource scheduling process uses real-time dynamic programming algorithms to effectively reduce the computational complexity. Simulation results show that the proposed scheduling scheme can help to match high trust and low migration rate vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Control of PWM Rectifier Voltage
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: PWM rectifier has the advantages of high power factor and low harmonic pollution, and usually adopts double closed loop control method of voltage outer loop and current inner loop in synchronous coordinate system. Since it is difficult to reflect the nonlinear nature of the voltage equation by using only linear PI control, this paper introduces nonlinear fuzzy control, combines fuzzy control with PI control, and combines the advantages of both. Using the fast adjusting ability of fuzzy control and the steady-state precision of PI control, the fuzzy-PI control method is adopted. The fuzzy adaptive PI control is adopted to adjust the parameters online to overcome the shortage that the PI adjustment parameters are fixed and cannot be adjusted. Simulation results show that both fuzzy control methods improve the dynamic and static performance of the system.

articleTitle: Structure Design of Planar Transformer Winding
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to reduce the volume of the magnetic component, the operating frequency of the magnetic component is generally increased. However, as the operating frequency increases, skin and proximity effects will increase the winding losses. At the same time, in the low-voltage and high-current DC/DC power supply module, method of parallel winding usually be used to increase the current carrying capacity of the winding. But the skin and proximity effects will lead to the unevenly distribute of parallel winding current, resulting in a higher AC resistance. In this paper, by using the orthogonality between the skin and the proximity effect, it is concluded that the cross-transposition technique can reduce the winding loss, and the symmetric cancellation principle is used to derive the arrangement of the current parallel division of the secondary parallel winding in the turns ratio of n:1.method. Finally, the effectiveness of the current equalization method of the secondary parallel winding of the planar transformer is verified by Maxwell 3D.

Author Keywords: planar transformer Cross winding Current sharing

articleTitle: Aggregated Load Prediction Based on Convolutional Long and Short-Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, the proportion of air-conditioning is increasing. Due to modeling difficulties and the different user habits, the current prediction error of air-conditioning load is large. Thus, this paper uses the idea of data-driving modeling and proposes a kind of convutational long short term neural networks (ConvLSTM) based on deep learning to build air-conditioning aggregation model. Experiments show the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Link Prediction in Weight Social Networks Based on Time Series
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Link prediction is an important task in social network analysis, the core of which is to predict the establishment of future links between nodes in social network. A weighted network model based on time information is proposed. Because the preference of nodes in the network will change with external factors, the time decay factor is introduced into the algorithm through the logistic function. The link weights between node pairs are determined by the link establishment time information, and the weighted network is used to improve the effect of supervised learning link prediction. Experiments were carried out on the academic co-author network, and the weighted network model was constructed to predict the links using supervised learning technology. The results show that this method is superior to the traditional weighted network method in Accuracy, f-measure and AUC.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Cyber Physical System Based On Fast Analytic Method
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With deepening research of Active Distribution Network (ADN), the reliability calculation efficiency of cyber physical system (CPS) has become a key factor restricting its practicality, so a fast evaluation method is urgently needed. This paper proposes a fast method to calculate the cyber link validity considering the transmission efficiency. The failure probability of cyber link is superimposed on the rejection rate of switching in distribution network. The switches model considering cyber failure is established and the reliability of distribution CPS under cyber failure is calculated.

Author Keywords: cyber physical system, reliability evaluation, fast analytic method

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Fluid Velocity Changes on the Vibration of Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Pipeline will vibrate due to fluid-solid coupling, and the vibration is often harmful, so how to reduce the vibration becomes an important research topic. In this paper, the finite element analysis method is used to study the stress changes of the pipe bending part and the vibration of the straight pipe section under various conditions of fluid velocity changing. The results show that in order to reduce the maximum stress and vibration, the fluid velocity should increase steadily, and in the finite increasing time, the later increase of the fluid velocity should be as gentle as possible. It can provide guidance for the operation of valves or other fluid control components in the pipeline for practical operation.

articleTitle: Non-Contact Electrocardiogram Dry Electrode Design
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: We present a gel-free, non-contact dry electrode based on a PCB for electrocardiogram(ECG) recording. We designed the electrode as a 1.5-inch round plate. The fabricated electrode has an amplifier with low power consumption and high-impedance input and a high-frequency filter circuit. Integrated circuit of the fabricated electrode can reduce noise pickup and increase gain. Through this experiment we compared the ECG obtained from a disposable wet electrode and the ECG obtained from dry electrode, and both of all can see clear ECG recorded signals.

articleTitle: Research on Sizing Method of Tram Vehicle Hybrid Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In order to design a well-performing hybrid storage system for trams, optimization of energy management strategy (EMS) and sizing is crucial. This paper establishes a mathematical model of battery and supercapacitor, compares the topology used in trams. Using adaptive particle swarm optimization(PSO) to optimize the size of battery and supercapacitor. Simulation calculation based on the operating data of traction calculation curve and analyzes the impact of choosing different EMS and different topologies on the size results.

Author Keywords: tram, hybrid storage system, sizing, energy management strategy, adaptive particle swarm optimization

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Digital Image Processing Technology in Film and Television Garments
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the development of the time, the aesthetic concept changes constantly, and the audience's aesthetic demand for film and television clothing is also higher and higher. In the whole film and TV series, costume design is not passive, but participating in creation and keeping pace with the time. For a long time, when the effect diagram of clothing creation is transformed into clothing, it is limited by materials, and the innovation of materials is often ignored by people. Based on this consideration, this paper, with the help of computer digital image processing technology, discusses and explores innovative methods of material selection in film and television clothing, so as to improve viewers' visual experience of the overall effect of film and television clothing.

articleTitle: Bending Experimental Study on Composite Single Hat Stiffener Panel in Different Environments
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Hat stiffener is one of the main structural forms of composite stiffened panel. When the hat stiffener panel buckles to a certain extent, the skin and stiffener will bend and becomes debonding failure. In order to test the effect of environment and materials on the bearing capacity of the structure, three point bending test was carried out on composite single hat stiffener panel in three different environments. The effect of different materials and environments on the bearing capacity of the structure are obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Optimized Algorithm for Heart Rate Value Deviation of Elderly Bracelet
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In the study of wearable devices which can measure heart rate, the deviation of heart rate value will greatly affect the function of the bracelet. An optimized algorithm is proposed to determine the heart rate value and it's reasonable range by using behaviour recognition. The algorithm uses the combined acceleration, combined angular velocity and threshold to determine the three behavioral states of a person, including walking, running and stillness. The accuracy of the heart rate value was increased by 10% compared to the previous test data.

articleTitle: The Architecture Design of Government Microblog Matrix Management System Based on Unified Modeling Language
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Government microblog is one of the important online communication modes of socialized participation, discussion and inquiry in politics in contemporary China. The matrix mode of government microblog is helpful to strengthen the inter-departmental, cross-level and cross-regional linkage of government microblog, which is one of the hot research directions at present. Based on the operation process, we used UML technology to propose a system architecture and database design method of microblog matrix management system, which established the reasonable granularity of functional modules and found the balance between data redundancy and data correlation to ensure the efficiency and reliability of the whole system. The architecture design method proposed in this paper has certain reference value for the research of related fields.

articleTitle: Pairwise-Constraints Based Semi-Supervised Fuzzy Clustering with Entropy Regularization
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Compared with traditional unsupervised clustering, semi-supervised clustering is a more powerful computing method and plays a vital role in pattern analysis and machine learning. The reason for these is that semi-supervised approaches can take advantage of semi-supervised information, which can significantly boost the performance of clustering. Existing methods for semi-supervised fuzzy c-means clustering (FCM) suffer from the following issues: it is generally uneasy to assign the appropriate membership degree value based on traditional entropy regularization using semi-supervised information involved in their objective function. To address this problem, we systematically propose a novel Fuzzy Symmetric Relative Entropy Clustering with Pairwise-Constraints (FSREC-PC) by introducing entropy regularization into the objective function. Moreover, FSREC-PC introduces symmetric relative entropy as a regularized term in its objective function such that its resulting formulas have the clear membership meaning compared with the other semi-supervised FCM algorithms. Further experiments conducted in UCI data show that the proposed clustering algorithm can derive a better performance.

articleTitle: A Review on Sentiment Analysis Model for Chinese Weibo Text
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: the technology of sentiment analysis about Chinese Weibo text is a complex and systematic model. In general situation, it includes 3 parts: data washing, word segmentation and feature extraction. Weibo text is an unstructured text and there are many non-standard contents in it. Therefore, it should be thoroughly data washing before feature extraction. Due to emoticon in Weibo text are very useful in sentiment analysis, thus, in data washing, all of Non-Chinese, with "@","#" character should be removed except emoticon. In word segmentation, related algorithms can be divided into three categories: based on string matching, based on understand and based on statistics[1]. In feature extraction, the Lexicon-based Model, Machine learning Model and deep learning Model usually was used. Through literature search, the paper found that grammar characteristic in Chinese Weibo text was fully considered and solved by program of Lexicon-based Model, sentiment word, for example, adverb of degree, no word and all kinds of Chinese sentence patterns. But, due to characteristic of poor generalization, the performance of Lexicon-based Model in experiment is not good. Therefore, performance the model should be continued to improve. For traditional machine learning, there are 2 mainly aspects of innovation: Simultaneous classifier (Adoboost+SVM) and Improvement of classical classification algorithm. One worth noted is that the performance of the some improve classifier (SVM, P Naïve Bayes) has not been verified in Chinese Weibo classification. For deep learning, now, the innovation point is mainly focus on Convolution layer and input attention mechanism. For the next step, YuanHejin think should input ensemble learning and attention mechanism should be improve. LuXin argue that the recognition performance about irony sentence with context in Weibo needs to improve. GaoWeiju think that individual sentiment space for each user in EMCNN model should be build.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Book Recommendation Algorithm Based on Context Awareness and Social Network
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: The resources of university libraries are constantly enriched, and the needs of users are increasingly diversified and personalized. It is difficult to find the resources they want in time. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a hybrid book recommendation algorithm based on context awareness and social network. The algorithm firstly obtains the user's current task and context information, and then calculates the context entropy and context weight to represent the influence degree of different context factors on resource selection. Traditional Pearson similarity is combined with the similarity calculated by the neighborhood-based social network layer to get the hybrid user similarity. The final prediction results are obtained by the hybrid weighting process of the users' prediction scores in different context. Finally, the algorithm is tested by experiments. The results show that the proposed algorithm outperforms traditional collaborative filtering algorithm in precision and recall rate.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Safe Driving Behavior of Transport Vehicles Based on K-SVM-XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In recent years, the total number of transport vehicles in China is increasing by a large margin, strengthening traffic safety management to effectively prevent accidents has become the focus of traffic research. The driver as the operator of vehicle, its driving behavior is the most important factor affecting the traffic safety. Therefore, it is of great significance to study driving behavior to prevent traffic accidents and promote the development of intelligent traffic and driving assistance system. Based on the data of the Internet of vehicles, this paper builds a SVM-based driving behavior health evaluation model, which extracts the feature values to obtain the optimal classification hyperplane, and then uses the geometric interval as the evaluation index of driving behavior health. At the same time, taking driving behavior, road, efficiency, energy saving and weather factors with different weights into consideration, it divides driving behavior into four levels: excellent, average, qualified and unqualified level, based on KMeans and SVM, and then XGBoost training model is used. The experiment concluded that the average accuracy is 99.21% and the average recall rate is 98.5%. These results proved that the model is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Weighted Model of Air Defense Weapon-Target Assignment Based on AHP and Entropy Method
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: In many previous studies, the analytical model of weapon-target assignment (WTA) is only based on the maximum damage to hostile targets. In order to overcome the deficiency of single decision-making, three sub models are established, which not only take the maximum damage to hostile targets, but also minimum loss and shortest interception time as the optimization objectives. In the meantime, the established models combine the air defense operation pattern and the characteristics of multiple air defense platforms. Based on the sub models, a weighted WTA model is proposed in this study using analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and entropy method. Through optimization, the optimal air defense WTA scheme is obtained by the weighted WTA model, and the optimization results are analyzed. Comparative study demonstrates that it is more reasonable to optimize the WTA scheme with multi-objectives.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Text and Application Based on the Latent Dirichlet Allocation
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Chinese text research has always been a hot and difficult point in natural language processing. On the one hand, Chinese and English are very different in grammar, resulting in the uniqueness of Chinese word segmentation. On the other hand, Chinese part of speech tagging methods are also different from English. To some extent, the above two points hinder the research and application of natural language processing technology in Chinese text. The paper presents a word segmentation algorithm for Chinese text, and then introduces how to use vector space model to represent Chinese text. At the same time, the topic number k is given according to different criteria for measuring text clustering in order to build the Latent Dirichlet Allocation model base on Guangdong Province consumer complaint text. Through the model to assist the administrative departments to formulate corresponding policies, to grasp the key points of complaints accurately and quickly for the administrative personnel.

articleTitle: Application of Biogeography-Based Optimization for Tuning Multimachine Power System Stabilizer Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Biogeography-Based Optimization (BBO) algorithm, a novel optimizing algorithm, is applied in optimal tuning of multimachine Power System Stabilizer (PSS) parameters. The tuning of fixed-structure lead-lag type PSS parameters is formulated as a quadratic performance optimization problem. An eigenvalue-based objective function is chosen to maximize the damping ratio of the electromechanical modes at different system operating conditions. BBO algorithm, robust to the initial solution and computationally efficient compared with other meta-heuristic algorithms, such as Genetic Algorithm (GA), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Evolutionary Strategy (ES), is employed to search for optimal PSS parameters. Simulations are carried out on two typical multimachine power systems. Both frequency-domain eigenvalue analysis and time-domain dynamic simulation verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed BBO based PSSs under a wide range operating conditions. Moreover, the superiority of the proposed BBO algorithm is further illustrated by algorithm optimization performance evaluation and dynamic response damping characteristic compared with GA, PSO and ES. Keywords: Biogeography-Based Optimization (BBO), electromechanical oscillations, multimachine power system, parameter optimization, Power System Stabilizer (PSS).

Author Keywords: Biogeography-Based Optimization (BBO), electromechanical oscillations, multimachine power system, parameter optimization, Power System Stabilizer (PSS)

articleTitle: Application of Cryptographic Technology Based on Certificateless System in Electricity Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With the construction of Internet of things, relying on big data, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, Internet of things and blockchain and other new technologies, data integration between various network systems has been accelerated and the gap between data islands has been broken. However, due to the large scale of terminal access, complex business operation relationship, network system vulnerability and more and more loopholes, the traditional network security technology is difficult to ensure the security of the system. This paper proposes to solve the security problems caused by large-scale terminal access by using the certificate-free security mechanism based on domestic cryptography, so as to provide security guarantee for the construction of electricity internet of things. At the same time, in order to meet the security requirements of energy Internet information interaction, this paper proposes a decentralized key management idea to solve the traditional IBC (identity based Cryptograph) algorithm key update problem, improve the security management and control ability of the system, and comprehensively support the construction of world-class energy Internet enterprises with excellent competitiveness.

articleTitle: The Prospective of Library Spurred by Artificial Inteligence-China Survey
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is known as one of cutting-edge technologies in recent years, and many countries have taken its development as a national strategic planning. The changes that AI brings to social will be universal; and libraries are no exception. Changes brought about by AI development to the library will mainly be embodied in three aspects, i.e., environment, resources and services. As a result, the future library will be of intelligent library space, intelligent resource system and intelligent customer service. The current research on the application of AI to Chinese libraries covers all aspects of library management and service. At present, the intelligent consulting robots and the book inventory robot have been applied in some libraries of China.

articleTitle: Research on Informatization Construction of Government Audit Under the Background of Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Since the 1990s, computer technology has developed rapidly in China, and has gradually penetrated into accounting and auditing work. Traditional auditing work has failed to meet the modern information quality requirements and has been replaced by audit informatization. In order to meet the challenges brought by informatization, the National Audit Office started the "Golden Audit" project in 2002, and gradually carried out the informatization construction of government audit in China. With the in-depth development of information technologies, human beings are marching toward the era of big data. The integration of big data technology and audit informatization has become an irresistible trend. This paper analyzes the status quo of informatization construction of government audit in China under the background of big data era, then points out the existing problems. On this basis, some suggestions for improvement have been proposed tentatively, expecting to be helpful to the informatization construction of government audit in China.

articleTitle: A Study of the Factors Influencing Consumer Intention of Mobile Shopping Based on Structural Equation Modeling
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: With mobile shopping developing rapidly in our country, it is very urgent for companies to grasp the methods that can stimulate consumer intention of mobile shopping, but the researches about this are not enough. Thus, this paper discussed the factors that influencing consumer intention of mobile shopping through structural equation model, literature research and other methods. The results show that consumer innovativeness, convenience, and entertainment have positive impacts on consumer intention of mobile shopping. The results cannot only enrich the behavior research theories of mobile shopping, but also can provide guidance for enterprises to develop mobile sales terminal marketing activities and for the government to construct mobile technology environment.

articleTitle: A Remaining Useful Life Prediction Model for Complex Electromechanical Equipments Based on Stochastic Process and Condition Data
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd International Conference on Advanced Electronic Materials, Computers and Software Engineering (AEMCSE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of residual life prediction of complex mechanical and electrical equipment, an improved Wiener process residual life prediction model is proposed. Firstly, aiming at the nonlinearity of degradation process of complex mechanical and electrical equipment, the general Wiener process prediction modeling method is improved, and a residual life prediction model based on random coefficient Wiener process is proposed. Secondly, aiming at the parameter estimation of degradation process, Based on the health assessment of the equipment, the distribution parameters of the process parameters are estimated by using the historical state data of similar equipment, and a construction method of the prior distribution of the degradation process parameters based on the state data is proposed. Finally, the information fusion is carried out by using Bayes statistical inference to construct the posterior distribution and Bayes estimation of the degradation process parameters, and the residual life of the equipment is estimated Life prediction. The case study shows that the residual life prediction model proposed in this paper has higher prediction accuracy and lower prediction uncertainty.
